description: This file defines the Validator interface used for validation purposes within the Eclipse Ditto project, providing methods to check validity and retrieve failure reasons.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A general purpose interface for validation, with methods to determine validity and obtain failure reasons.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if the validation was successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the reason for validation failure if any.
